title: Audit Event Envelope
description: Generic append-only audit event envelope for future service-emitted events. This contract intentionally avoids mortgage pricing domain constants and production replay guarantees.

eventId.description: Stable unique identity for the emitted audit event.

sourceService.description: Logical service or component that emitted the event.

aggregateType.description: Source-defined aggregate category for correlation and replay filtering.

occurredAt.description: Timestamp when the source event occurred.

recordedAt.description: Optional timestamp when the event was recorded into an audit/outbox stream.

sequence.description: Optional source ordering token for append-only consumers.

causationId.description: Optional upstream event or command identity that caused this event.

partitionKey.description: Optional partitioning hint for future ordered processing.

payload.description: Generic event payload owned by the source service.

payloadRef.description: Optional reference to payload content when payload is stored separately.

metadata.description: Optional non-domain metadata for audit, replay, or trace tooling.
